_note: This file is the shared source of truth for live Lodestar contract addresses. Values below are placeholders — update each field after every deploy so contributors can verify WASM hashes against on-chain state and point at the same deployments.

contracts.name: LodestarServiceRegistry
contracts.description: Service registry — discovery, registration, reputation voting, and category filtering.

contracts.name: LodestarAgents
contracts.description: Agent credit scoring — identity, credit scores, spending policies, and administrative controls.

verification.obtainWasmHash: Run `sha256sum <wasmPath>` from the `contract/` directory after `stellar contract build`. The hash is also printed by `stellar contract install --wasm <wasmPath>`.
verification.obtainDeploymentLedger: The ledger number is printed by `stellar contract deploy`. You can also look up the contract on the Stellar Explorer.
verification.verifyDeployment: Compare the on-chain WASM hash (visible on the Stellar Explorer contract page) against the `wasmHash` field in this file. They must match byte-for-byte.
